description: Implementation of the HostResolverMdnsTask class for handling mDNS hostname resolution, including transaction management, result parsing, and asynchronous completion handling.

classes.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Transaction
classes.description: Handles individual mDNS query transactions, manages callbacks, and stores results.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::ParseResult
methods.description: Parses DNS record data into HostCache::Entry based on query type.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::CheckCompletion
methods.description: Checks if all transactions are complete or if any have errors, then triggers completion.

methods.name: HostResolverMdnsTask::Complete
methods.description: Finalizes the task, cancels incomplete transactions, and runs the completion callback.
